notes: The hierarchy and conditional Backtester delegation support feedback-driven operation, but detailed execution traces and controller rules are absent. Temporal validity is limited to incrementally revealed historical data in case studies; cross-validation chronology and separation from ten-year DRL backtests are unspecified. Profit examples are theoretical, with no transaction-cost or risk-adjusted evaluation. RAG, generic dynamic-context/memory descriptions, and dynamic scaling are not established as separately contributed mechanisms. No LLM parameter training is reported.
